purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: U.S.–Russia ties run through many thin channels, not one relationship
question: How do Russia's presidential-security system, war economy, nuclear status, alignments, commodity routes and constrained U.S. relationship fit together?
bluf: The U.S. and Russia deal with each other through a patchwork: strained diplomacy, nuclear deterrence with no treaty after New START expired, ad hoc Ukraine talks, sanctions run through licenses and waivers, and a few working exceptions like the space station. Russia's trade has moved toward Asia and third countries, not stopped.
evidence_cutoff_note: Country structure was checked against Russian constitutional, presidential, government, legal-publication, budget and central-bank sources; U.S. bilateral state against State, Treasury, Commerce, Energy, NASA, Congress and White House sources; and territorial, institutional and economic boundaries against the United Nations, OSCE, Council of Europe, IMF, World Bank, EAEU, CSTO, SIPRI, EIA and USGS. Wave 1 established the country and source orientation. Wave 2 classified recognition, diplomacy, risk-reduction, terminated and expired arms-control instruments, sanctions and export controls, ad hoc war talks, consular channels and ISS operation. Wave 3 mapped wartime fiscal and monetary perimeters, Russia's China- and third-country dependencies, U.S. and allied nuclear/mineral/energy/space exposures, and the distinct legal weights of the China, DPRK, Iran, CSTO, EAEU, SCO, BRICS and Union State relationships. Current consolidated Russian constitutional text, post-New-START arrangements, legacy risk-reduction use, H.R. 5334 implementation, budget execution, transaction-level trade/payment routes, treaty-performance receipts and people-to-people operation remain named return gates.
use_note: Use as the country-level front door before opening a Russia question. It routes rather than replaces the Ukraine settlement, H.R. 5334, oil/gas, sanctions, nuclear-fuel and monetary evidence owners. Keep Russian domestic claims, internationally recognized borders and time-stamped physical control separate; keep treaty obligation, invocation, delivery and operation separate. Registration does not authorize Chronicle promotion, a watch, app/site shipment, commit or push.
